overview: A hiring manager's part in hiring is the interview: prepare, meet the candidate, give feedback. Your profile menu is the same as any member's; interviews reach you through your notifications and your email.

rules: You can change your scorecard until the recruiter closes the round.

website: The list of all your interviews. In the app, open each one from its notification or from the link in the email.

menu.pages: My applications · My saved jobs · Search jobs

menuTitle: What a hiring manager's menu shows
